body: End-to-end verification of the bi-directional instant ping, using the bridge itself. Steps: 1) Reply to this task by pushing a small result file to muse-inbox/ (name: muse-20260929-pingtest-result.json, reply_to: muse-20260929-pingtest, status done). That push should trigger the GitHub Action's Hermes->Muse step. 2) Check that Actions run's log and confirm the Discord dispatch step actually POSTed to the webhook (look for the curl step succeeding). 3) In your result file, report: the Actions run URL, whether the alert message appeared in Discord #general, and the exact text posted. Do not put any secrets or webhook URLs in any file.
title: End-to-end ping test: Hermes->Muse Discord alert
